official.text: Route 3.4 supports nonproductive demonstrations: testing and evaluating a technology, process, method or approach that is new or unknown in AL20 and transferable to similar settings. Participation must be open to those entitled to it, with objective selection if places are limited, and the activity and results must be disseminated. The route excludes a final objective of improving productive-sector competitiveness. Eligible applicants are specified public bodies, nonprofit legal persons and qualifying publicly owned companies; a score does not establish applicant or cost eligibility.

follow_up.text: Publish information about the demonstration online from its start and results as they become available; retain this information for at least three years after final payment. The demonstration must produce usable, disseminable results by completion. Check the special rules for demonstration-only property investments and retain grant records for the applicable control period.

official.text: Route 3.5 supports nonproductive conservation, protection, rehabilitation and recovery of rural heritage, including environmental heritage. Establish the heritage value and how the work protects it; include dissemination and/or public use, with an opening or public-use plan for enclosed sites. Standalone studies or one-off training, promotion and demonstration activities are excluded. Agricultural-production support and forestry work primarily increasing economic productivity are excluded. Applicants and costs must separately satisfy this route.

follow_up.text: Plan how the recovered heritage will remain in its approved use and how public use or dissemination will operate; for an enclosed site specify visiting days/hours or other public-access mechanisms. Where a forest-management plan or equivalent is required, it must be valid at application and the operation must be consistent with it. Apply the relevant investment commitments and record-retention duties; ask AL20 which apply to the proposed works.

demonstration-design.text: For 3.4, frame the restoration component as a documented comparison or trial: explain what is new in AL20, what will be evaluated, who can participate and how others will use the results. Choose measures the project can actually deliver; equipment or planting alone does not establish a demonstration.

heritage-recovery-design.text: For 3.5, connect the proposed component to an identified environmental or rural heritage asset, its conservation needs and a public-use or dissemination plan. Keep workshops and outreach ancillary to an eligible recovery operation; a standalone event or report is excluded by this route.

AT.3.1-restoration.text: Identify the actual settlement in the INE Nomenclator, record its population and reference year, and ask AL20 which benchmark applies. Use the existing lookup only as an explicit provisional assumption; do not move the stated site or use the whole municipality without saying so.

AT.3.2-restoration.text: Check the actual settlement population against the separately published Andalusia median using a consistent year. Record the source and retain the comparison; the two population alternatives are not cumulative.

CO.1.1-restoration.text: Use the existing EDL references to identify one relevant NPL needs in the LEADER-addressable list. For each, write a short link from the published need to an activity, intended result and delivery evidence. Do not count one need repeatedly or claim unrelated social objectives.

CO.1.2-restoration.text: Use the existing EDL references to identify two relevant NPL needs in the LEADER-addressable list. For each, write a short link from the published need to an activity, intended result and delivery evidence. Do not count one need repeatedly or claim unrelated social objectives.

CO.1.3-restoration.text: Use the existing EDL references to identify three or more relevant NPL needs in the LEADER-addressable list. For each, write a short link from the published need to an activity, intended result and delivery evidence. Do not count one need repeatedly or claim unrelated social objectives.

RD.5.1-restoration.text: Record the municipality, applicable business count and ZRL mean, then explain the support delivered locally, such as a genuinely accessible heritage resource. The published 2025 AL20 mean is 60; the median of 21.5 is a different statistic and is not the local criterion benchmark.

CC.2.1-restoration.text: Consider renewable equipment only where the restoration operation genuinely needs it. Specify the equipment, energy source, intended use, commissioning and maintenance responsibilities, and confirm that the purchase is an eligible cost for the selected route.

CC.7.1-restoration.text: Only investigate collective transport if participant access makes it necessary. Document the vehicle, energy technology, users and operating plan; do not add a vehicle merely to improve the score.

CC.7.2-restoration.text: If the site needs public or operational charging, check the installation location, connection requirements, technical feasibility, permissions and who will operate it. First confirm compatibility with the restoration route.

CC.7.3-restoration.text: Use this only if a municipality is delivering a genuine plan-backed access measure connected to the operation. Identify the plan action and ask AL20 whether it belongs in this route or another municipal operation.

IG.8.1-restoration.text: Work with local women to define the space, intended activities and barriers it addresses. Link the design to documented EDL demands and arrange its use and upkeep; keep the component within the selected route's purpose.

IG.8.2-restoration.text: Use the existing women's-priority EDL references to identify a relevant demand, then co-design a specific programme, accessible times and participation arrangements. Explain the connection in the assessment notes.

IG.8.3-restoration.text: Consider women-led landscape photography, oral-history or creative interpretation with a clear equality objective. Specify the participants, creative outputs and approach to challenging stereotypes.

IG.8.4-restoration.text: Only consider this if a genuine women-demanded sporting activity belongs in the operation. Explain how its design addresses participation barriers and relates to the site, rather than relabelling normal restoration work as sport.

IG.11.1-restoration.text: If local women want an enduring organisation, establish its purposes, founding members and governance, then obtain registration. Check whether creation of the association is part of an eligible operation; do not assume changing the promoter's name is enough.

IG.11.2-restoration.text: Describe the association's actual needs and its restoration-related role before proposing equipment. Record use, responsibility and delivery, and ask whether the purchase is compatible with the chosen route.

IG.11.3-restoration.text: Agree a substantive delivery role with a rural women's association. Describe its programme, equality objective, responsibilities and outputs, keeping the action connected to the restoration operation.

IG.11.4-restoration.text: If a network would support the project beyond one event, agree its purpose and membership, complete the required approvals and retain the relevant agreement. Avoid creating a nominal network just for points.

IG.11.5-restoration.text: Consider a practical session explaining why and how to join or establish relevant rural associations, with accessible materials and a clear target audience. Retain the programme and actual dissemination outputs.

IG.11.6-restoration.text: Identify the actual sector and verify it against the official annex. If it qualifies, develop a substantive action supporting women's participation, such as mentoring or access to relevant technical roles, and record the measures delivered.

IG.11.7-restoration.text: Use the existing EDL references to select a documented topic, agree content with participating women and describe how the event contributes to the restoration project. Plan evidence of content and delivery from the outset.

DRI.3.1-restoration.text: Have a competent professional assess relevant barriers and the legal baseline. Consider suitable improvements such as accessible interpretation, audio description or sensory adaptations, and document precisely what exceeds the minimum.

DRI.3.2-restoration.text: Identify the staff who will directly work with participants, assess the relevant support skills and arrange suitable training before delivery. Retain named attendance and completion evidence.

DRI.3.3-restoration.text: Use the inclusion-related EDL references to identify a specific need and work with a relevant local organisation to design the response. Describe the users, accessibility/support arrangements and intended result without assuming all volunteers are a vulnerable group.

JR.3.1-restoration.text: Develop a course with a competent provider: define learning outcomes, practical content, audience, trainer and delivery schedule. Explain how the skills can be used, and retain completion evidence.

JR.3.2-restoration.text: Contact a relevant education provider, define supervision, learning tasks and responsibilities, and obtain a valid official agreement. Verify current placement requirements with the provider and AL20.

JR.3.3-restoration.text: If a real position is needed, document the graduate's qualification date, return to the territory and employment arrangement. Confirm the detailed return/age tests before relying on the criterion; do not invent employment to increase the score.

JR.3.4-restoration.text: Design a session around actual opportunities for youth contribution to the restored site or demonstration. Include concrete participation routes and responsibilities rather than delivering a generic planting talk.

JR.3.5-restoration.text: Develop a genuine youth-designed leisure activity connected to the resource, with clear access, supervision and delivery arrangements. Describe the activity explicitly and distinguish it from paid work or volunteer labour.

JR.3.6-restoration.text: Give a youth group a substantive role in planning, decisions or ongoing stewardship. Define its responsibilities, support and outputs, and document how the action improves participation.

JR.3.7-restoration.text: Do not add a commercial activity merely to claim these points. If a genuine youth-serving business component is proposed, seek written AL20 classification of the operation and eligible route before including it in the assessment.

JR.3.8-restoration.text: Use the existing youth-related EDL references to select a genuinely relevant need. Explain who benefits, the proposed response and how it will be delivered; do not assume any environmental activity meets youth needs.

IN.1.1-restoration.text: Read the existing EDL explanation of the absent sector designation and leave this claim unresolved unless AL20 provides documented clarification. Investigate IN.1.2 and IN.1.3 for actual designated themes/aspects instead; this does not change an existing saved answer.

IN.1.2-restoration.text: Use the existing five-theme EDL list, choose the theme the operation genuinely addresses and write a short explanation supported by planned activities and outputs. Request the GDR's justification; do not claim every theme because the project is environmental.

IN.1.3-restoration.text: Use the existing twelve-aspect EDL list and check each relevant aspect's restrictions. Explain the concrete design choice that implements it and retain the project description and intended outputs for GDR review.

PT.1.1-restoration.text: Describe the degraded resource, baseline condition, intended recovery and subsequent use. Prepare the relevant technical project or activity memorandum and a realistic public-use/dissemination plan; connect each claimed benefit to the works or activities.

PT.1.2-restoration.text: Identify the actual practice, its EDL reference and knowledgeable local practitioners. Design a preservation or transmission action with clear content and outputs, keeping it subordinate to the selected route's purpose where necessary.

PT.1.3-restoration.text: Use the existing heritage EDL references to identify the action, then explain the resource, need, proposed intervention and intended use. Document the precise strategy passage and obtain GDR confirmation.

PS.1.1-restoration.text: Check whether the actual applicant already has relevant active cooperative membership in AL20 and obtain the certificate. Only investigate new membership if it has a genuine purpose and the applicant remains eligible for the selected route.

PS.1.2-restoration.text: Review the relevant organisation's statutes and the EDL objectives using the existing references. Obtain active-membership proof and explain how its documented purpose corresponds to the strategy; ask the GDR to confirm the match.

PS.1.3-restoration.text: If the applicant belongs to such an organisation, obtain the membership certificate and relevant statutory passages. Explain the territorial rural-development purpose and seek GDR confirmation rather than inferring it from the organisation's name.

PS.3.1-restoration.text: Review the applicant's previous LEADER awards and disclose them accurately. If no previous award is known, ask AL20 to arrange the official check; do not assume a new project title establishes first-time status.

SP.1.1-restoration.text: Only explore this if the project genuinely delivers a new qualifying service. Identify users, the unmet need, service operator and ongoing delivery; ask AL20 whether it is a proximity service and which route should fund it.

SP.1.2-restoration.text: If there is a genuine existing service, describe its present users and limitations, the proposed improvement and who will deliver it. Seek AL20 classification before counting an environmental amenity as a proximity-service improvement.

SP.1.3-restoration.text: Consult a relevant service provider about a real need, then define the promotion activity, audience and delivery evidence. Keep claims limited to the activity actually planned, with separate AL20 confirmation of route fit.

official.text: The operation settlement must have fewer inhabitants than the AL20 municipality-population median. The local table specifies INE 2023; the later guide refers to latest published data. This is an alternative to AT.3.2, not an extra population award.

restoration.text: This depends on the actual restoration location and its settlement population, not on the number of trees or ecological ambition.

application.text: Applicant: identify the settlement in the application form and descriptive memorandum. GDR: check the official settlement population against the applicable reference table; FUND-010 Annex I, PDF pp. 113 and 126, provides municipality benchmarks, not a list of settlements.

payment.text: Applicant: confirm the settlement in the payment form and delivery memorandum. The guide requires consistency between application and payment locations.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the applicable reference year: FUND-004 says 2023, while the later guide and current lookup use 2025. Do not mix years or treat equality as below the benchmark.

official.text: The operation settlement must have fewer inhabitants than the Andalusia-wide municipality-population median. This is the alternative population band; it cannot be added to AT.3.1. Confirm the applicable year and published benchmark.

restoration.text: A restoration location may satisfy this wider benchmark even if it does not satisfy the AL20 benchmark. This remains a location fact.

application.text: Applicant: state the settlement in the application form and descriptive memorandum. GDR: verify its INE Nomenclator population and the Andalusia reference; see FUND-010 PDF pp. 10-11 and Annex I p. 126.

payment.text: Applicant: confirm the settlement in the payment form and delivery memorandum.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: The guide narrative mentions 2,497 inhabitants while its 2025 annex and the app lookup use 2,256. Ask AL20 to confirm the applicable year and benchmark rather than choosing the more favourable value.

official.text: The operation must address one distinct prioritised needs identified in the applicable AL20 EDLL. Select the corresponding count alternative; strategy priority rankings are not selection points.

restoration.text: Restoration can address evidenced territorial needs, but a general environmental description does not prove a match. Each claimed need needs its own explanation of what the operation delivers.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum identifying the operation objectives, characteristics and the prioritised EDL needs addressed. GDR checks the correspondence; the final subsidy-eligibility report from the territorial delegation must confirm the fit.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the selected NPL needs, the applicable strategy edition and whether the proposed activities actually address each need. Selecting a supporting EDL reference in the app is not official confirmation.

official.text: The operation must address two distinct prioritised needs identified in the applicable AL20 EDLL. Select the corresponding count alternative; strategy priority rankings are not selection points.

restoration.text: Restoration can address evidenced territorial needs, but a general environmental description does not prove a match. Each claimed need needs its own explanation of what the operation delivers.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum identifying the operation objectives, characteristics and the prioritised EDL needs addressed. GDR checks the correspondence; the final subsidy-eligibility report from the territorial delegation must confirm the fit.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the selected NPL needs, the applicable strategy edition and whether the proposed activities actually address each need. Selecting a supporting EDL reference in the app is not official confirmation.

official.text: The operation must address three or more distinct prioritised needs identified in the applicable AL20 EDLL. Select the corresponding count alternative; strategy priority rankings are not selection points.

restoration.text: Restoration can address evidenced territorial needs, but a general environmental description does not prove a match. Each claimed need needs its own explanation of what the operation delivers.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum identifying the operation objectives, characteristics and the prioritised EDL needs addressed. GDR checks the correspondence; the final subsidy-eligibility report from the territorial delegation must confirm the fit.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the selected NPL needs, the applicable strategy edition and whether the proposed activities actually address each need. Selecting a supporting EDL reference in the app is not official confirmation.

official.text: The operation must support a municipality with fewer businesses than the ZRL mean specified in the local AL20 table. This uses business counts, not inhabitants or the business median.

restoration.text: The restoration project needs a credible connection to the municipality being supported. Being located there does not by itself demonstrate the claimed support.

application.text: Applicant: application memorandum naming the municipality and the business figure from the applicable public source. GDR compares with FUND-010 Annex V; the guide says the annex figure prevails if the submitted figure differs.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the applicable statistical edition and explain which municipality the operation supports; do not treat a location lookup as a certificate of territorial benefit.

official.text: Acquire and commission qualifying renewable-energy equipment within the operation. The guide requires a description of the technology and energy source, followed by proof of actual acquisition and its characteristics.

restoration.text: A justified renewable supply could support a public demonstration or heritage facility. Trees storing carbon, using hand tools or describing a project as low-carbon does not satisfy an equipment-acquisition criterion.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum stating technical characteristics, technology and renewable energy source of the proposed machine or equipment.

payment.text: Applicant: invoice and technical sheet or manufacturer certificate; where appropriate, a competent-person report/certificate verifying the technology and energy source. Demonstrate actual acquisition and implementation.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: The printed list also mentions blue hydrogen and liquefied natural gas. Do not reinterpret these as automatically renewable; request AL20 clarification for the specific technology and expense.

official.text: Acquire a collective passenger-transport vehicle using qualifying green energy. The vehicle must actually be acquired; ordinary private car use is not the same activity.

restoration.text: Transport could help eligible participants reach a demonstration or heritage activity, but a vehicle purchase needs a genuine operational purpose and separate cost-eligibility checks.

application.text: Applicant: justification based on supplier information describing the vehicle, green technology and intended use.

payment.text: Applicant: invoice, vehicle technical sheet, DGT label and photographic record showing the acquired vehicle.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 whether the proposed vehicle and its use qualify under both this criterion and the selected route's eligible costs.

official.text: Install an electric-vehicle charging point. Scoring concerns an actual installation with technical and conformity evidence, not a general intention to encourage sustainable travel.

restoration.text: A charging point might serve an existing public-use heritage facility, but it has limited relevance to a planting-only project.

application.text: Designer or municipal official: report describing the proposed installation; applicant includes it with the operation memorandum.

payment.text: Authorised control body (OCA): conformity/homologation certificate for the installation under ITC BT-52, as specified by the guide.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm that the installation belongs within the funded operation and that its expenditure is permitted; a scoring criterion does not itself authorise the purchase.

official.text: Municipal measures such as pedestrianisation, cycle lanes, bicycle parking, park-and-ride facilities or high-occupancy-vehicle measures must fall within a sustainable-mobility plan.

restoration.text: This generally requires a municipal mobility intervention. A nature trail or a private promise to travel by bicycle is not automatically the same measure.

application.text: Designer or municipal official: report on the mobility measures, and project or mobility plan describing the actions; applicant links this to the memorandum.

payment.text: Works director or municipal technical official: certificate of executed measures, with acceptance record and/or works certifications as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the municipal role, plan coverage and route classification before claiming a mobility measure for a restoration site.

official.text: Create infrastructure or spaces for women's use, with an activity programme responding to women's demands established in the EDL participatory process.

restoration.text: A space connected to a restoration resource could support activities women have requested. Merely allowing women to visit an otherwise general site does not establish the criterion.

application.text: Applicant: justification memorandum specifying the activity programme and the demands agreed by women through the EDL participatory process.

payment.text: Applicant: delivery memorandum and, as applicable, use-transfer agreement, execution project, final works certificate, acceptance record and photographs.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the identified demand and whether the proposed space is an eligible component of 3.4 or 3.5 rather than a separate infrastructure project.

official.text: Implement activities clearly demanded by women in the applicable EDL. The programme must identify the actual strategy need being addressed.

restoration.text: Restoration-related activities may contribute when they answer a documented demand from women. A general environmental workshop does not establish that demand.

application.text: Applicant: justification memorandum describing the activity programme and the EDL need recording women's demand.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, content programmes, documentary or graphic evidence, publicity materials, photographs or streaming recordings as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 to confirm that the specific demand is documented and that the activity fits the selected route.

official.text: Deliver sociocultural activities fostering women's creativity, designed to break gender roles and stereotypes rather than perpetuate them.

restoration.text: Creative interpretation of environmental heritage could provide a meaningful activity if its gender objective is explicit; women appearing in photographs is not sufficient.

application.text: Applicant: justification memorandum with an activity programme explaining how its design challenges gender roles and stereotypes.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, publicity, photographs or streaming recordings.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the substantive gender approach and ensure the activity is a compatible project component, particularly under 3.5's exclusion of standalone events.

official.text: Design sporting activities with a gender perspective, linked in the guide to women's demands in the EDL and supported by an explicit programme.

restoration.text: A restoration landscape may host outdoor activities, but routine walking or volunteer planting is not automatically a gender-focused sporting programme.

application.text: Applicant: justification memorandum detailing the sporting programme and the EDL need in which women demand it.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, programmes, documentary or graphic evidence, publicity, photographs or streaming recordings.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the gender approach, EDL demand and compatibility of the sporting activity with this restoration route.

official.text: Create an association or federation of rural women. This concerns the actual creation of that organisation, not simply collaboration with women or an existing mixed association.

restoration.text: An organisation might have a genuine long-term role in environmental stewardship. Creating one solely as a scoring device is not a restoration result.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum describing objectives, social purpose, initial structure and available resources, plus the founding act of the association/federation.

payment.text: Applicant: delivery memorandum, statutes and certificate of registration in the official association/federation register; GDR verifies actual creation.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 how association creation relates to the restoration operation and eligible applicant status.

official.text: Maintain or equip an association of rural women. The proposed assets or works must serve that association; an unrelated project purchase does not demonstrate this condition.

restoration.text: An established women's association might need suitable equipment or a space for its role in a heritage project. This is different from buying planting supplies for any promoter.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum stating purpose and characteristics of the equipment; where relevant, a basic project identifying works, actions and equipment.

payment.text: Applicant: delivery memorandum and, as applicable, execution project, final works certificate, acceptance record and photographs.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm whether maintenance/equipment support is eligible within this operation; scoring does not override the route's cost rules.

official.text: Activities must be carried out by a rural women's association and linked to reducing gender inequalities. Inviting an association to an event is not the same as that association delivering it.

restoration.text: Women-led stewardship, interpretation or learning could contribute when the association genuinely organises the action and its equality purpose is documented.

application.text: Applicant/association: descriptive memorandum specifying the activity programme.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, publicity, photographs or streaming recordings.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the association's role and equality objective with AL20 rather than treating attendance as delivery.

official.text: Create or join a network of rural women's associations. The guide checks the legal or organisational steps establishing the network or membership.

restoration.text: A real network can share stewardship experience or environmental-heritage activities, but an informal contact list alone does not establish integration.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum explaining objectives and resources needed to create or join the network.

payment.text: Applicant/association: delivery memorandum and statutes, agreements, conventions or another legal document proving network creation or membership.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm which organisation must create/join the network and what evidence AL20 will accept.

official.text: Disseminate the value of association membership, especially to groups such as young women or women with disabilities. The activity must actually explain and promote association-building.

restoration.text: An environmental project could help women understand stewardship associations and participation opportunities. Ordinary project publicity does not automatically serve this objective.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum with objectives, speakers, content, format, duration, date, place and intended audience.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, publicity materials, photographs or streaming recordings.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Check the association-building content and compatibility with the selected route; a generic project launch is not enough.

official.text: Promote women's participation in a sector where they are underrepresented. The guide refers to the official SDR list of masculinised sectors based on IECA data.

restoration.text: Some restoration roles may fall in an underrepresented sector, but forestry or technical work must not be assumed to qualify without the published classification.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum describing the intended participation measures and the masculinised sector targeted.

payment.text: Applicant: delivery memorandum describing measures implemented, using the SDR masculinised-sector list as reference.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the sector classification and the measures AL20 considers sufficient; a gender-balanced photograph or team is not itself the specified action.

official.text: Organise meetings, workshops, forums or webinars on subjects of interest to women that are recorded in the EDL. Establish a direct connection between the documented subject and the activity.

restoration.text: A restoration project can provide a setting for a women-demanded discussion or exchange, provided the topic is evidenced in the strategy and the event has a real purpose.

application.text: Applicant: programme in the descriptive memorandum. Instructing GDR: justification report identifying the relevant needs in the EDL.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum and evidence of content, programmes, publicity, documentary/graphic records, photographs or streaming recordings.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 to confirm the EDL topic and obtain the GDR justification; selecting a strategy reference is not a substitute.

official.text: The promoter's facilities and processes must be adapted for people with disabilities, already or through the operation, beyond the minimum required by applicable sector legislation. Compliance with mandatory minimums alone is insufficient.

restoration.text: A public-use restoration site or demonstration can reduce participation barriers through physical or non-construction adaptations. The improvement above the legal baseline must be established.

application.text: Applicant: baseline-versus-proposed justification memorandum identifying adaptations beyond legal requirements.

payment.text: Competent technician: report identifying the reference law, elements exceeding its minimum and evidence of improvement. This is required for non-construction adaptations too; a supplier technician may issue that report where appropriate. For works: execution project, final certificate, acceptance record and photographs; the works director can issue the technical report.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the applicable accessibility rules and the improvement beyond their minimum; the app does not certify legal compliance.

official.text: Staff directly involved in the operation must have, or receive through it, training in assisting vulnerable groups at risk of social exclusion.

restoration.text: Staff guiding inclusive restoration participation may need relevant training. General ecological knowledge does not establish training in support for vulnerable groups.

application.text: Applicant: training certificate or responsible declaration committing to training and identifying the staff attending. The guide limits this commitment to staff directly connected to the funded operation.

payment.text: Applicant/training provider: delivery memorandum and certificate proving the training.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm whether the proposed course content and staff roles satisfy AL20's interpretation.

official.text: The operation must respond to at least one specific EDL-identified need concerning people at risk of social exclusion. General public benefit is not the same as a specified inclusion need.

restoration.text: Inclusive access to a restored resource could contribute when the population, barrier and strategy need are clearly identified.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum describing objectives, characteristics and purpose. Instructing GDR: justification memorandum confirming the need in the applicable EDL.

payment.text: Applicant: delivery memorandum explaining the needs addressed and their correspondence with the EDL.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the identified population/need and the GDR justification.

official.text: Deliver courses for young people that improve their skills and employability. The course must have defined content and participants; informal volunteering is not automatically a course.

restoration.text: Restoration skills, monitoring or heritage interpretation may provide useful training where learning and employability outcomes are substantive.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum with objectives, speakers/trainers, content, format, duration, date, place and target audience.

payment.text: Training provider: report on content, attendees, place and timing; retain programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, publicity, photographs or streaming recordings as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the applicable youth definition and that the course is compatible with the chosen route; 3.5 does not fund a standalone training operation.

official.text: The promoting entity participates in dual vocational training or has an official placement agreement for young people. An informal offer to host volunteers does not establish an official placement.

restoration.text: An appropriate restoration or heritage organisation might host supervised learning through a recognised educational partnership.

application.text: Educational centre and host entity: signed collaboration agreement, included with the descriptive memorandum. FUND-010 refers to the applicable official dual-training/placement framework.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: The guide cites an older dual-training legal framework. Confirm the currently applicable agreement requirements and payment-stage proof; the app does not validate a placement contract.

official.text: The operation must bring recently graduated young people back to the rural area and into paid employment or self-employment within the ZRL. The printed criterion limits the time since relevant qualification to twelve months.

restoration.text: A genuine qualifying returner could work on restoration or monitoring. A short volunteer visit or a planned job without evidence is insufficient.

application.text: Applicant/participant: identity document and responsible declaration of professional activity in an AL20 municipality or settlement.

payment.text: Participant/applicant: identity document, official qualification certificate, RETA registration or registered employment contract and employment-history report, as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 which records establish return, the youth age requirement and the twelve-month qualification period. Check employment costs and duration separately.

official.text: Provide awareness or training on how young people can contribute to local development. The activity must clearly identify its purpose, audience and content.

restoration.text: A restoration project can show young residents meaningful roles in local environmental stewardship and decision-making.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum with objectives, speakers, content, format, duration, date, place and target audience of the awareness/training activity.

payment.text: Provider/organiser: report on content, participants, place and timing; programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, publicity, photographs or streaming recordings.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the intended audience and the distinct activity being claimed; training subjects or attendance alone do not prove the specific local-development purpose.

official.text: Promote leisure and free-time opportunities for rural youth. Identify the actual activity being assessed; a normal works task is not automatically a leisure programme.

restoration.text: A restored landscape could support appropriate youth outdoor recreation, provided the operation retains its restoration-route purpose.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum describing objectives and characteristics; basic project where investments are proposed.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, programmes, documentary/graphic proof, publicity and photographs. For investments, include execution project, final works certificate, acceptance record, photographs and planned dissemination evidence as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 whether the activity is a compatible component; a standalone leisure event must not be treated as eligible heritage recovery under 3.5.

official.text: Promote youth association-building, social participation and community involvement, or improve rural young people's situation and quality of life through a clearly identified action.

restoration.text: Young residents can take an active role in stewardship and interpretation, rather than simply being counted among visitors.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum describing objectives and characteristics; basic project for proposed investments.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: delivery memorandum, programmes and documentary/graphic evidence, publicity and photographs. For investments, include execution project, final works certificate, acceptance record and dissemination evidence as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the specific participation action and distinguish it from ordinary attendance or temporary volunteer numbers.

official.text: Create or support a business that diversifies its activity to offer products or services for young people. The offering must be of demonstrated interest to the youth audience.

restoration.text: This business-oriented criterion has limited fit with nonproductive restoration routes. A possible scoring condition does not make a productive business operation eligible under 3.4 or 3.5.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum describing objectives and characteristics of the youth-oriented business line, activity or resulting product.

payment.text: Applicant: payment memorandum demonstrating the youth interest of the selected product/service and relevant IAE/CNAE registration certificates.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Resolve the tension between this business-oriented criterion and the selected route's nonproductive requirements. The guide allows substantiated youth-interest evidence beyond the EDL, but this does not override route exclusions.

official.text: The operation must address a specific youth need identified in the applicable EDL. Clearly establish the link between the need and the proposed action.

restoration.text: Restoration participation may respond to a documented youth need when it provides the specific opportunity or improvement described in the strategy.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum describing objectives, characteristics and purpose. Instructing GDR: justification memorandum identifying the need in the applicable EDL.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 to confirm the strategy need, youth definition, required GDR justification and delivery evidence.

official.text: The operation must belong to an economic sector designated innovative in the applicable EDL. The reviewed AL20 strategy uses innovative themes and aspects instead and does not designate innovative economic sectors.

restoration.text: A restoration project must not invent an innovative sector or treat environmental technology as proof of a designation the strategy does not make.

application.text: Instructing GDR: justification memorandum confirming the operation falls within an innovative sector in the latest applicable EDL. The absence of a designated AL20 sector is therefore a substantive obstacle, not a missing app list.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: How, if at all, can AL20 apply this printed subcriterion when the reviewed EDL does not designate innovative sectors? Obtain written clarification before claiming it.

official.text: The operation must address a theme designated innovative in the applicable EDL. AL20's reviewed strategy identifies five themes; novelty claimed by the applicant is not enough.

restoration.text: A restoration approach may relate to a designated theme when the project explains the actual connection and result.

application.text: Instructing GDR: justification memorandum confirming that the operation addresses a designated innovative theme in the latest applicable EDL.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the designated theme, applicable EDL edition and GDR justification. A selected EDL reference or a sensor purchase is not certification.

official.text: The operation must incorporate an aspect designated innovative in the applicable EDL. The reviewed AL20 strategy identifies twelve aspects, some with specific local conditions.

restoration.text: A restoration design, collaboration or dissemination method may contribute if it implements a named aspect and satisfies its conditions.

application.text: Instructing GDR: justification memorandum confirming incorporation of the innovative aspect in the latest applicable EDL.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the chosen aspect and any territory-specific limitation; broad claims of innovation are insufficient.

official.text: Bring an infrastructure, facility or natural, monumental, architectural or artistic heritage element into value for subsequent use through physical interventions, training, dissemination or awareness actions.

restoration.text: This is a potentially relevant criterion for recovering environmental heritage. Identify the heritage resource and the public value of the proposed action rather than treating any private planting as heritage enhancement.

application.text: Applicant: justification memorandum with objectives and characteristics of training/dissemination/awareness actions. For investments, a basic project demonstrating how the heritage element is brought into value for subsequent use.

payment.text: Applicant/technical team: delivery memorandum appropriate to the action; for works, execution project, final certificate, acceptance record and photographs. For events/dissemination, programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, publications/publicity, web links and photographs as applicable.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the heritage classification, subsequent use, land rights and eligibility of the actual intervention with AL20. Scoring under PT.1.1 does not override the selected route's exclusions.

official.text: Promote, disseminate or conserve traditional local trades, practices or gastronomic specialities contemplated in the EDL. A generic heritage activity without the specified traditional subject is insufficient.

restoration.text: Restoration may connect to an evidenced traditional landscape practice or craft, but contemporary planting work must not be labelled traditional without support.

application.text: Applicant: memorandum with objectives, speakers, content, format, duration, date, place and audience. Instructing GDR: memorandum justifying the EDL-identified need. The guide also accepts supporting academic/historical studies, essays or journalistic work.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: programmes, documentary/graphic evidence, leaflets, media/web publicity and photographs showing delivery.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm that the practice is contemplated in the applicable EDL and that the operation fits the route; a standalone cultural event is excluded by 3.5.

official.text: Carry out another rural-heritage action identified in the EDL as of possible interest. The action must be objectively supported by the applicable strategy.

restoration.text: A restoration project might address a documented environmental-heritage action, but an interesting site alone does not demonstrate the required preservation action.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum with objectives, characteristics and purpose. Instructing GDR: justification memorandum identifying the need in the applicable EDL; relevant academic, historical or journalistic sources may also support the claim.

payment.text: Applicant: delivery memorandum; for works, execution project, final certificate, acceptance record and photographs. For other actions, programmes, documentary/graphic records, publications/publicity, web links and photographs.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the EDL-identified action and route fit; the heritage interest must be documented rather than inferred.

official.text: The promoter must be an active member of a first- or second-degree cooperative structure. The guide specifies that its territorial scope is the ZRL.

restoration.text: This is a promoter-membership fact, not a reward for informal cooperation or buying plants from a cooperative.

application.text: Cooperative/entity: certificate proving the applicant's active-member status; applicant includes the relationship in the descriptive memorandum.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm qualifying cooperative structure, active status, territorial scope and any timing condition. Membership does not change nonprofit/applicant eligibility by itself.

official.text: The promoter must be an active member of an organisation whose stated purposes include an EDL cross-cutting objective. Membership and the correspondence of objectives must both be demonstrated.

restoration.text: A real association relationship could support environmental stewardship, gender or youth objectives. Working informally with another organisation is different from membership.

application.text: Organisation: active-member certificate and statutes recording its purposes. Instructing GDR: report confirming correspondence with cross-cutting objectives in the latest applicable EDL.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 to confirm the membership, purposes and GDR report; neither a partnership promise nor selection of an EDL reference proves this condition.

official.text: The promoter must be an active member of an organisation whose purposes include promoting rural development or endogenous development in the ZRL.

restoration.text: An established rural-development network may support a restoration initiative, but the criterion concerns documented membership and statutory purposes.

application.text: Organisation: certificate of active membership and statutes. Instructing GDR: report confirming rural-development or endogenous-development purposes in the ZRL.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm qualifying active membership and the GDR interpretation of the organisation's purposes; check the criterion cap before combining membership claims.

official.text: The applicant must never have been a beneficiary in previous LEADER calls. This concerns the actual natural or legal person applying, not whether this restoration project is new.

restoration.text: A new restoration project by an established beneficiary does not erase that applicant's grant history.

application.text: Applicant: claim the condition in the application memorandum and provide a responsible declaration during the hearing stage. GDR arranges the electronic check with SGCAFDR, followed by the official certificate or signed report; the guide describes GIRO/GEA checks.

payment.text: No separate payment-stage document is specified for this subcriterion in the reviewed guide section. This is not an exemption from the route's general payment and delivery requirements; confirm the applicable proof with AL20.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Have AL20 confirm the applicant's history across programming periods and how it will obtain the official verification.

official.text: Create a new quality proximity service for the population. The guide describes person-oriented support for autonomy, remaining in one's usual environment and social integration; a new visitor attraction is not automatically such a service.

restoration.text: The relevance to a planting-only operation is limited. An actual person-centred service associated with the site needs separate classification and route checks.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum specifying the new service's objectives, characteristics and target audience.

payment.text: Applicant: payment memorandum. As relevant, execution project, final works certificate and acceptance record; technical sheets for equipment; CNAE/IAE registration for the activity/service.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm the meaning of proximity service for this proposal and its compatibility with 3.4/3.5; do not assume a nature trail or workshop qualifies.

official.text: Improve an existing quality proximity service, demonstrating the initial situation and the improvement. This is an alternative to creating a new service under SP.1.1.

restoration.text: A restoration site may connect to an existing person-centred service, but better habitat or visitor signage does not automatically improve that service in the specified sense.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum with objectives and characteristics of the service improvement and a before-versus-proposed comparison.

payment.text: Applicant: payment memorandum and, as applicable, works project/final certificate/acceptance record, equipment technical sheets or CNAE/IAE registration.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Confirm that the existing service and proposed improvement meet the criterion and the chosen route's purpose.

official.text: Promote proximity services for dependent people. Identify the specific service and promotion action; general accessibility alone is not identical to this condition.

restoration.text: There may be a connection where an actual dependent-person service uses the resource, but a general public-use restoration project should not assume this criterion applies.

application.text: Applicant: descriptive memorandum stating objectives, characteristics and purpose of the promotion action.

payment.text: Applicant/organiser: justification memorandum, event programmes, leaflets, press/radio/web publicity and photographs as appropriate.

follow_up.text: The reviewed criterion section does not specify separate later-control evidence for this subcriterion. General route, investment and record-retention commitments still apply; see Official route conditions and confirm the applicable duties with AL20.

unresolved.text: Ask AL20 which service and promotion measures qualify and whether they are eligible components of the restoration operation.
